fixtures.name: One proof-system lower bound promoted to P not equal NP
fixtures.invalid_inference: Superpolynomial proofs in one propositional proof system prove P is not NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The lower bound does not apply to every Cook-Reckhow proof system and targets a stronger coNP question even then.
fixtures.witness: A different proof system may have short proofs for the same tautologies.
fixtures.remediation: Retain the named-system lower bound or prove the full proof-system statement and its exact implication.

fixtures.name: Resolution lower bound promoted to NP versus coNP
fixtures.invalid_inference: Haken's resolution lower bound proves NP is not coNP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Resolution is only one Cook-Reckhow proof system.
fixtures.witness: Lower bounds for one system do not rule out a different polynomially bounded system.
fixtures.remediation: State the resolution result and do not widen its proof-system quantifier.

fixtures.name: NP equals coNP identified with P equals NP
fixtures.invalid_inference: Proving NP equals coNP would prove P equals NP, or proving P differs from NP would prove NP differs from coNP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Only P=NP implies NP=coNP; the converses are not known.
fixtures.witness: The implication lattice leaves NP=coNP with P versus NP unresolved.
fixtures.remediation: Use only the valid direction NP not equal coNP implies P not equal NP.

fixtures.name: Time hierarchy theorem promoted to P versus NP
fixtures.invalid_inference: Deterministic time hierarchy supplies a language outside P, so P differs from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The separated language has not been placed in NP.
fixtures.witness: Hierarchy theorems separate deterministic time classes without identifying an NP language outside P.
fixtures.remediation: Supply a membership proof in NP and a compatible lower bound for that same explicit language.

fixtures.name: Diagonal language leaves the target class
fixtures.invalid_inference: A diagonal construction defeats every polynomial machine and therefore separates P from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The diagonal language may not lie in NP, may use an excessive simulation bound, or may not be decidable under the proposed encoding.
fixtures.witness: Diagonalization can readily construct languages in larger time classes while missing NP.
fixtures.remediation: Prove exact NP membership and account for universal simulation overhead.

fixtures.name: Oracle separation promoted to the unrelativized world
fixtures.invalid_inference: P^A differs from NP^A for some oracle A, therefore P differs from NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Relativized class relations do not determine the unrelativized relation.
fixtures.witness: Other oracles make P^B equal NP^B.
fixtures.remediation: Use oracle results only to classify proof methods or prove a separate unrelativized theorem.

fixtures.name: Nonrelativizing method treated as correct by classification alone
fixtures.invalid_inference: The proposed proof does not relativize, so it is a valid P-versus-NP proof.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Avoiding a barrier is not a correctness proof and the argument may fail elsewhere.
fixtures.remediation: Check every theorem step independently; record barrier escape only as a method property.

fixtures.name: Natural-proofs barrier treated as an absolute impossibility theorem
fixtures.invalid_inference: Natural Proofs proves that general circuit lower bounds cannot be established.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The barrier is conditional and applies to a specific constructive-large-useful method class.
fixtures.witness: Non-natural or assumption-violating routes are not ruled out by the theorem.
fixtures.remediation: State the cryptographic hypothesis and the exact naturalness properties.

fixtures.name: Non-natural property promoted to a useful lower bound
fixtures.invalid_inference: A property is not natural, therefore it proves a strong circuit lower bound.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Non-naturalness alone gives no usefulness, explicitness, or lower-bound theorem.
fixtures.witness: An arbitrary sparse property can evade largeness while saying nothing about small circuits.
fixtures.remediation: Prove the property applies to the explicit target and excludes the claimed circuit class.

fixtures.name: Nonalgebrizing route treated as a proof
fixtures.invalid_inference: The method does not algebrize, therefore it resolves P versus NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Barrier evasion is necessary for some routes but never sufficient for correctness.
fixtures.witness: A flawed combinatorial argument may fail to algebrize and still be false.
fixtures.remediation: Retain the barrier classification and verify the substantive proof independently.

fixtures.name: Derandomization theorem promoted to P versus NP
fixtures.invalid_inference: Hardness versus randomness results directly settle P versus NP.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The required hardness assumption or explicit hard function is not supplied, and the conclusion concerns randomness.
fixtures.witness: A conditional derandomization implication does not establish its hardness premise.
fixtures.remediation: State the assumption and exact randomized class consequence.

fixtures.name: SAT speedup transfer used outside its theorem regime
fixtures.invalid_inference: Any modest SAT heuristic improvement yields a major circuit lower bound.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The algorithm, circuit class, worst-case exponent, uniformity, and closure hypotheses do not match the transfer theorem.
fixtures.witness: Algorithm-to-lower-bound theorems have exact quantitative and model-specific premises.
fixtures.remediation: Instantiate every premise and prove the qualifying worst-case speedup.
